client_providers.label: n8n workspace
client_providers.purpose: Imports and runs the inactive workflow starters.
clientProvides: Your client-owned n8n URL and workspace owner
client_providers.secretDestination: No credential is required to test the synthetic starter.
steps: Run the synthetic test and keep it inactive.

client_providers.label: WhatsApp Business Platform / Cloud API
client_providers.purpose: The channel the replier listens on and replies through, with a dedicated business number.
clientProvides: Meta business verification, a WhatsApp Business Platform account, and a dedicated number
Approved message templates for follow-ups and the client-owned webhook subscription
Decision on whether per-message fees are included in the monthly fee or passed through at cost
steps: Connect the channel adapter to a test number first.
Run the full test pack, including handover and opt-out paths, before going live.

client_providers.label: Scheduling / calendar source (optional)
client_providers.purpose: Source of truth for open slots when the booking module is on; availability is never invented.
clientProvides: Calendar or booking system name, API documentation, and service/provider mapping
Permitted scopes and a named booking owner
steps: Test lookup misses, stale availability, and double-booking protection.

client_providers.label: AI provider (optional)
client_providers.purpose: Adds language understanding beyond the deterministic intent rules after the demo is understood.
clientProvides: Approved prompt, data-handling policy, and cost owner
steps: Create the provider credential in n8n.
Connect it only after the synthetic test, output schema, and prompt review are approved.

client_providers.label: Lead sheet / CRM (optional)
client_providers.purpose: Stores collected enquiry details for quote requests and lead capture, and alerts the team.
clientProvides: Sheet or CRM name, vendor API documentation, field mapping, and permitted scopes
Team alert destination and consent/message policies
steps: Test a synthetic event, error path, and duplicate protection.
Verify the human alert path before activation.
